title: Introduce autoscaler hysteresis tuning and burst snapshotter for smoother SLA-preserving scaling
author: Aisha Kumar
description: Motivation: fleet-level oscillation during short-lived demand spikes has caused tail latency SLO regressions for Dedicated customers. This PR introduces two complementary changes: (1) an adjustable autoscaler hysteresis policy that reasons over multi-window percentiles and a compacted 'settle' decay to avoid flip-flopping when utilization hovers around thresholds, and (2) a lightweight burst snapshotter that captures ephemeral high-throughput intervals and exposes them to the scheduler so the autoscaler can apply short-term crediting rather than immediate costly scale-outs. Changes include operator-config knobs, rollout feature flag, and observability to validate effect. Scope: runtime autoscaler algorithm, controller config, telemetry & dashboards, unit and integration tests. Checklist: - Add hysteresis policy implementation and config knobs; - Add burst snapshotter and store with TTL and summarized metrics; - Expose new signals to autoscaler and planner; - Add end-to-end integration test that replays synthetic burst traces and asserts no SLA regressions; - Add metrics + dashboard panels for settle events and burst crediting; - Implement feature flag + staged rollout; - Update docs/options reference. Deployment plan: behind feature flag; enable for a small Dedicated fleet subset via console toggle; monitor settle_count, scale_events, 95p latency, and burst_credit_hits for 72h before wider rollout. Related: ENG-4128 (autoscaler stability), ENG-4181 (burst accounting).

testing_notes: Unit coverage added for hysteresis math and boundary conditions; integration test replays a recorded 45s spike with three 1s microbursts and asserts no more than one scale-out in the 60s window; added a perf-smoke that simulates 10k concurrent requests at 95th percentile to verify KV cache behavior remains stable.
observability_changes: New metrics: dedicated.autoscaler.hysteresis.decision{pool,decision}, dedicated.autoscaler.settle_events, dedicated.burst.snapshot_count, dedicated.burst.credit_hits. Dashboard 'Dedicated Autoscale — Settling & Bursts' includes histograms for settle latency and a heatmap of burst snapshot density.
rollback_plan: Disable feature flag to revert behavior instantly; fallback removes burst signals and reverts to previous autoscaler path; alerts configured to page on scale_event_rate > 5x baseline or 95p latency > 1.5x target for 10m.
release_notes: Adds an autoscaler hysteresis policy and a burst snapshotter to reduce oscillation during short transient demand spikes. Behind feature flag; initial rollout limited to a small Dedicated fleet subset. Expected: fewer unnecessary scale-outs and improved 95p latency stability during ephemeral bursts.
post_merge_actions: Monitor published metrics for 72h; iterate on settle_decay_factor using ENG-4181 telemetry; follow-up task created to add auto-tuning experiment for settle_decay (ENG-4299)

notes: This PR focuses on production stability rather than peak savings; initial defaults favor conservative scale-down avoidance. The burst snapshotter was implemented with restricted memory footprint (<2MB per pool) and evicts summaries deterministically by timestamp to remain predictable.
